prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A meticulously detailed Victorian-era street scene centered on an old-fashioned millinery shop. The shopfront features ornate green and gold woodwork, large display windows, and a prominent sign reading "MILLINER." A whimsical banner hangs above the window, boldly stating, "Hatters will say this is AI." The window display showcases an array of elegant hats—top hats, bowlers, and straw boaters—arranged neatly on wooden stands, each hat rendered with realistic textures and subtle shadows. Standing confidently in front of the shop is a distinguished gentleman in period attire: a tall black top hat, a deep navy frock coat with gold trim, a tan waistcoat, high-collared white shirt, and dark trousers. His expression is serious yet slightly amused, hands at his sides, exuding the poised demeanor of a 19th-century shopkeeper. The cobblestone street and neighboring storefronts are softly blurred, drawing focus to the milliner and his wares. The color palette is rich and warm, with deep greens, golds, and browns, illuminated by gentle, natural daylight that casts soft, realistic shadows. The composition is balanced and painterly, with a slight cinematic depth of field, evoking the charm and precision of a period film or a masterfully rendered digital illustration.
